messages.subject: 'tkrplot' package error stops shiny from deploying on shinyapps.io
parts:
Is the error with me or on shinyapps.io?

if I try
install.packages("tkrplot")
I get an error 

if I try
install_github("cran/tkrplot")
no errors.

if i try to publish my shiny app i get
ERROR: compilation failed for package �tkrplot�
* removing �/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/tkrplot�
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 184737224 failed: Error building image: Error building tkrplot (0.0-23). Build exited with non-zero status: 1
Execution halted

I have posted on stackoverflow:

R Shinyapp Error: compilation failed for package tkrplot

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] 'tkrplot' package error stops shiny from deploying on shinyapps.io
parts: Shinyapps.io does not support any packages that require access to the display so any packages that rely on tk will be impacted. Recall that shiny applications run on the server with the UI being the browser.
